name: Shara Resch
info: Helping small businesses figure out where AI actually helps, without the hype | CPD-Certified AI Adoption & Operations Strategist | Founder, SDR Creative Solutions | Speaker & Trainer
text: “Which AI tool should I use?” is usually not the first question I want a business owner asking. Today I’m recording my session for the upcoming AI In Motion Summit, and the topic reflects one of the biggest principles behind how I approach AI adoption: Stop starting with the tool. Start with the problem. Before deciding whether you need an AI assistant, automation, Voice AI, CRM workflow, chatbot, or anything else, get clear on what is actually happening. Where does the process slow down? What gets repeated? What depends on someone remembering? Where do customers wait? Where does information get lost? What task requires judgment, and what task is genuinely repetitive? Only then does the technology question become useful. Because the same AI tool can be valuable in one business and completely unnecessary in another. That’s also why I don't believe responsible AI consulting starts with a software demo. It starts with understanding the work. Technology comes after. I’m looking forward to sharing more of that perspective during AI In Motion in October. #AIAdoption #AIInBusiness #BusinessOperations #WorkflowStrategy #ResponsibleAI
